study: deterministic finite-horizon collision control under shift with a human-handover fallback (Theorem A)
fallback: s >= s_f: episode handed to a human before any motion (deferred; collision impossible)
update_rule: s <- max(0, s + eta * (collision - alpha_star)) after every episode; no clip on the safe side
shift: SEVERE scenarios in analysis/online_margin.py, same seeds and order as the online-margin final run
selection_statement: eta chosen so that alpha_star stays near 0.024 for K = 480; no held-out outcome of this rule was seen before freezing.
